entities.summary: Joseph Mathew Alexander Morrow is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman for the Unia Oświęcim of the Tauron Hokej Liga (THL). He was selected in the first round, 23rd overall, by the Pittsburgh Penguins of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the 2011 NHL Entry Draft and has previously played for the Boston Bruins, Montreal Canadiens, and Winnipeg Jets.
